description:
Connect the extension tool rendering system (ToolRender from Phase 6) to the ToolExecution component.

Implement:
- When rendering a tool call, check Dispatcher.get_tool_definition for custom renderCall/renderResult
- If present, delegate to the extension's render function instead of default display
- Pass ToolRender.Context with args, state, tool_call_id, invalidate callback
- Support render_shell: :self (extension controls full framing) vs :default (standard border)

Upstream: tool-execution.ts lines 72-76 (shell selection), renderCall/renderResult delegation
Depends on: ToolExecution component, Extension.ToolRender (Phase 6), Extension.Dispatcher
title: Custom tool renderers: wire ToolRender into ToolExecution
